definitions.AgreesOnReferences: (before after : List Payload) → (references : List (Key × Nat)) → Prop := ∀ reference ∈ references, before[reference.2]? = after[reference.2]?
definitions.replaceDictionary: (packed : IndexedDictionary.Packed Key Payload) → (dictionary : List Payload) → IndexedDictionary.Packed Key Payload := ⟨dictionary, packed.references⟩
definitions.RevisionCertificate: structure carrying before : List Payload, after : List Payload, references : List (Key × Nat), agreement : AgreesOnReferences before after references

theorems.decodeReference_eq_iff_lookup_eq: decodeReference before reference = decodeReference after reference ↔ before[reference.2]? = after[reference.2]?
theorems.agrees_symm: AgreesOnReferences before after references → AgreesOnReferences after before references
theorems.agrees_trans: AgreesOnReferences before middle references → AgreesOnReferences middle after references → AgreesOnReferences before after references
theorems.unpack_eq_of_agreement: AgreesOnReferences before after references → unpack ⟨before,references⟩ = unpack ⟨after,references⟩
theorems.unpack_replaceDictionary: AgreesOnReferences packed.dictionary after packed.references → unpack (replaceDictionary packed after) = unpack packed
theorems.unpack_pack_after: [DecidableEq Payload] → AgreesOnReferences (pack entries).dictionary after (pack entries).references → unpack (replaceDictionary (pack entries) after) = some entries
theorems.stale_slots_counterexample: Exists equally long dictionaries with identical valid references, decoding [11↦7,12↦8] vs [11↦8,12↦7].
theorems.failed_decoders_do_not_imply_agreement: Exists before/after/references whose actual unpack results are equal, but per-reference agreement fails because both decoders stop at an earlier invalid index.
